prompt:
A close-up photograph, vertical frame, of the shopping trolley of the first
reference picture, standing on its two black wheels on the grey granite
pavement in the morning sun, its wheels resting on the slabs with their
short shadow falling to the left of them at the bottom of the picture: the same bag of red and dark-green tartan, filled
with a long baguette, the green tops of two leeks and four oranges with plain
unmarked skins at the top. The trolley fills the lower two thirds of the
picture, and its black handle rises out of the top edge of the frame.

Behind it and further along the pavement to the left, out of focus, the open
tailgate and the brown boxes of the small white car of the second reference
picture, with the ochre facade above. The sun comes from the right of the
picture. The textures of real woven fabric, bread crust, leaves, citrus peel
and stone.
